walkableNote: THE FLOOR IN FRONT OF THE COUNTER. Measured on the candidate: the counter's base line is y700 across x640-1440 and the floor runs to the frame's foot; the band stops at 830, short of the frame, as Room 1's does. Nothing behind the counter is walkable -- 'Not with her at the counter' (doc 25). A first draft added a lobe up to the back-room door (x1440-1652, y612-700); sliced into three bands it made the far and middle bands lobe-only and put every approach point on the near edge, so the door is approached from the floor line instead.

scaling.note: ROOM 5 DECLARES ITS OWN DEPTH FROM ITS OWN ARCHITECTURE (doc 36 Q10), read on plate-02. lit.note: THE HANGING WORK LAMP (Tyler, owner ruling 2026-09-04): one small plain period oil lamp on a short chain from the brass cage top rail, over the ledger. The fixture is this one prop in every visual state -- day and night -- cut from the in-context edit (art/staging/room-05/lamp-01/lamp.json); only its runtime light differs, by the room lamp below. Always lit; there is no unlit state. It hangs at the cage, in front of her: `occludes: [1]` puts it in the figure pass over plane-1 figures, so where its base meets her hair the lamp is in front.

rest.note: THE PROUD FLOORBOARD AT REST, iteration 2 (Tyler's rejection of iteration 1, 2026-09-05): the middle-band plank between the door step and the joint at x~745, its own pixels lifted unevenly out of the accepted plate by tools/pixelart/floorboard.py -- two rows at the left end, four at the right -- with the gap dark under its near edge. pressed.note: The plank flush under a foot: the plate's own pixels. Held a moment after the step, then back to rest.

step.caption: CREEEAK
step.note: The tread is the wood: the plank's own rectangle (cols 462-745, rows 746-788 between its two seams), not the hotspot rect. Thad's feet baseline swept across it presses the board once, says CREEEAK over the board as a world sound and fires doc 45's R05-FLOOR-STEP; standing on it is silent; it re-arms when his feet leave the wood.

lamps.note: The hanging work lamp's light: a small oil flame, so slow and low. Negligible by day (daylight is the source); by night the principal work light, a restrained warm pool on the ledger, her hands and the counter around them, centred a little below the flame so it falls on the work and not on the ceiling. The stove has no runtime lamp and stays a painted accent, secondary. Errata 64d: the state is authored, selected by the room's visual state, never by a clock.
